players.product: Power Systems division: backup engines and gas engines for prime power at data centres; next-generation engine to replace the Series 4000, targeting the data centre market with increased power density (launch 2028)

quarterly_data.quarter: Rolls-Royce press release: Rolls-Royce launches new exhaust after-treatment system for (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Product launch (release): Rolls-Royce launched an SCR exhaust after-treatment system meeting IMO Tier III for mtu Series 2000 marine engines, being certified in collaboration with exhaust after-treatment specialist Eminox; all mtu Series 2000 models are now available with integrated SCR (a solution for the Series 4000 was launched earlier). It is designed for a service life of up to 16,000 operating hours depending on the load profile and reduces nitrogen oxide emissions by 75 per cent compared with the IMO II limits.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 16,000 operating hours; NOx emissions 75 per cent below IMO II limits
